notes.title: Version 1.0 Update -- About to Release!
notes.content:
## Feature

- Complete Paragraph mode, now can choose different paragraphs

## Fix

- Fix Leaderboard and score multiplier bug due to new word difficulty
- We doesn't know how to solve Russian windows related bug, in English windows, it runs correctly. 
Please reply us with player log file.

## Next Update

We will set this game as released at 6/11, the following will happens
- Slightly increase game price due to new updates before
- Reset leaderboard

Have fun to play this game.
